style: 巨型菌菇湿地，开放冠层与泥岸

rules.title: 沼泽
rules.scatter_rule: 大根木稀疏，小菌簇密集；发光物限制占比，不能每丛都发光。
rules.junction_rule: 公共湿地区不复制三套完整壳；植物避开所有出口，水岸必须连续。
rules.top_rule: 开放；根木构图不能形成连续室内顶。

ground.source: design_initial; measure runtime slope before acceptance

lighting.diagnostic: freeze exact camera and simulation; white ambient; fog/virtual lights disabled; bright background
lighting.acceptance: Diagnostic gaps are observations. Accept matched dark background/sky/fog joins when production lighting and supported light changes remain convincing; require local geometry for visibly lit gaps.

examples: root buttress, giant fungus stem, crooked root
large cap, shelf fungus, small cluster, unlit cluster
wet branch, leaf raft, broken shell
kit.root_policy: Roots and reeds attach to bank elevation; water litter at water level. Do not sink stems into a flat water sheet to conceal missing contact.
kit.assembly: One bank group owns shoreline, roots and adjacent fungi. Keep open sky between mushrooms; optional glow only on authored glow species.
kit.light_fx: Preserve swamp tint. Shared firefly batch and low mist; optional sheen is a surface response, not an extra light on every mushroom.
kit.junction: Shared wet clearing and continuous bank mask. Do not duplicate three water surfaces at common junction.
kit.lighting_acceptance: Choose open/atmospheric/hybrid/geometric. Compare diagnostic with production lighting and actual permitted changes before deciding roof asset scope.
